2390-3514-3966.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3514-3966.description:
Gain life.
Karlov of the Ghost Council triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2511-8207.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

880-6664-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6664-7892.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2921-3413-4875.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

341-2781-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

969-1563-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
969-1563-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
969-1563-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1978-2392-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

997-3020-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
997-3020-6701.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

729-5663--108.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control a Great Oak Guardian token.
729-5663--108.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Great Oak Guardian token.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
729-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.

1987-2468-2751-3573.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Tolarian Academy and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

617-4235-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least four.
617-4235-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Nyx Lotus.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

1242-1323-1719-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Vizier of Tumbling Sands each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-1719-3143.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1496-3263-4078-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1496-3263-4078-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

575-2296-2860.description:
Activate Starved Rusalka by paying {G} and sacrificing Proteus Machine.
When Proteus Machine dies, Yedora triggers, returning Proteus Machine to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Starved Rusalka ability, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Proteus Machine by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Proteus Machine's morph ability by paying {0}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

167-654-2034-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {C}{C}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice, as well as any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Cormela enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

2713-3371-4019.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
2713-3371-4019.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Codie has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have at least one instant and/or sorcery card in hand.
2713-3371-4019.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

1267-1795-4301.description:
Cast Metamorphic Alteration by paying {1}{U}, attaching it to Medomai, naming Mistmeadow Vanisher and causing Medomai to become a copy of Mistmeadow Vanisher.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Medomai triggers, exiling Metamorphic Alteration until your end step.
When Metamorphic Alteration leaves the battlefield, Medomai is no longer a copy of Mistmeadow Vanisher.
Deal combat damage using Medomai.
Medomai triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Medomai triggers, returning Metamorphic Alteration to the battlefield from exile attached it to Medomai, naming Mistmeadow Vanisher and causing Medomai to become a copy of Mistmeadow Vanisher.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

736-2232-3094-3475-4768.notablePrerequisites:
The World Spell has exactly two lore counters on it.
You have at least one non-Saga enchantment card in hand.
736-2232-3094-3475-4768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The World Spell triggers, putting a lore counter on itself.
The World Spell's third chapter ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and targeting it, copying The World Spell's trigger.
Resolve the copy of The World Spell's trigger, putting Copy Enchantment and any non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Choose to have Copy Enchantment enter the battlefield as a copy of The World Spell, with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Copy Enchantment triggers once, and Cloudstone Curio and Altar of the Brood each trigger twice.
Resolve both Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Copy Enchantment and any other non-Saga enchantment from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment trigger, putting it and the non-Saga enchantment onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

527-1458-5095.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.You control at least one additional creature without summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power five or greater.
527-1458-5095.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting any other creature you control without summoning sickness.
Cast Out of Time by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Out of Time enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Out of Time from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Out of Time trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1379-3259-3734-4248.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to Harnessed Snubhorn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-1379-3259-3734-4248.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Harnessed Snubhorn, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Harnessed Snubhorn trigger, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Harnessed Snubhorn.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Harnessed Snubhorn, then attach Breath of Fury to Phyrexian Metamorph, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Phyrexian Metamorph, triggering it and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, returning Harnessed Snubhorn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice Phyrexian Metamorph, then attach Breath of Fury to Harnessed Snubhorn, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat.

2037-3059-4847.notablePrerequisites: Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2037-3059-4847.description:
Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Malignus and dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

751-1037-2564-3459.notablePrerequisites:
Multani's Harmony attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
751-1037-2564-3459.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Clue token.
The Clue enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1781-1978-4667.description:
Cause Elvish Aberration to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat from step 2.

404-1251-1521-2105.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1251-1521-2105.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.
